provenance: The Vehicle Movement Cost Chart of rule 30, transcribed from the owner's copy of the 4th edition rulebook, page 11, where the chart is printed as a graphic beside rule 28.1. The project writes it in its own layout and ships no rulebook text (SR-07, DR-01).
Every cost is in half movement points, so the half point of a road move is the integer 1 and no rule path needs a fraction (NFR-05).
The chart has two cost columns: one for an armoured fighting vehicle and one for a truck or a jeep. `afv` and `truck` below are those two columns.
COT in the chart is the cost of the terrain moved into. A row of `terrain` is a COT and a row of `extra` adds to it.
A star in the chart marks a row that needs the breakdown die roll of rule 39.1, and two stars mark a row that a halftrack may not enter. `breakdown` and `no_halftrack` carry those two marks.
The chart gives no cost for a stone building hex or a cliff hexside. Both are `null`, which the code reads as not allowed.

shellhole.note: Rule 30: no additional cost for a vehicle, and 4 MP plus the cost of the terrain for a truck.

stone_building.note: Rule 30.1: a vehicle may not enter a stone building hex under any circumstance.

road.note: Rule 30 and rule 5.52: the move goes along the road, through the hexside the road crosses.

higher_terrain.note: Onto higher terrain than the vehicle occupied before.

each_vehicle_or_wreck.note: Rule 29.1 and rule 40.3: 2 MP for each vehicle or wreck in the hex, on top of the terrain.

outside_covered_arc.note: Rule 29.4: the hex entered is not in the covered arc the vehicle had.

unload_passengers.note: Rule 31.3: the vehicle pays this to let its passengers get off.

enemy_afv_hex.note: Rule 30.7: 4 MP for each vehicle plus the cost of the terrain.
